name: orpheus_run
prompt: Running in place toward the right (treadmill run, he stays in place): energetic run cycle, arms pumping, club swinging with the right arm, cape flowing behind.

name: orpheus_jump
prompt: Full jump in place: bends knees, takes off, rises with knees tucked, top of the jump, falls with legs reaching down, lands with a small squash.

name: orpheus_attack
prompt: Club attack: brief anticipation, winds the club back over his shoulder, strikes forward and down in front of him at waist height, follow-through, back to idle.

name: orpheus_crouch_attack
prompt: Crouches low, knees bent, body lowered to two thirds of his height, then from the crouch swings the club forward low along the ground, and stays crouched.

name: orpheus_air_attack
prompt: Jumps up, and in the air with legs tucked swings the club forward in a wide arc in front of him, then lands.

name: orpheus_hurt_death
prompt: Hit by an unseen blow from the front: recoils backward, collapses to his knees, falls onto his back and lies still.

name: orpheus_hold
prompt: Raises his left arm high above his head, open palm up, as if lifting a small treasure to the sky, proud; club stays down at his side; holds the pose.

name: eurydice_idle
prompt: Calm breathing idle, long golden hair and white dress swaying gently, hands together in front of her waist. She BLINKS ONCE in the middle of the clip.

name: elder_idle
prompt: Calm breathing idle of an old man leaning on his tall wooden staff, the staff stays planted on the ground in his right hand, beard moving slightly. He BLINKS ONCE in the middle of the clip.

name: merchant_idle
prompt: Calm breathing idle, holding the clay jar of golden ambrosia with both hands in front of her chest in every frame, friendly small head nod. She BLINKS ONCE in the middle of the clip.

name: villager_idle
prompt: Calm breathing idle, holding the basket of apples in the crook of her right arm in every frame, slight cheerful sway. She BLINKS ONCE in the middle of the clip.

name: zeus_idle
prompt: Majestic breathing idle, the lightning bolt stays raised in his right hand in every frame and crackles slightly, robes and beard stir gently. He BLINKS ONCE in the middle of the clip.

name: hermes_idle
prompt: Light, bouncy idle on his toes, the small wings on his hat and sandals flutter, the golden staff stays in his right hand in every frame. He BLINKS ONCE in the middle of the clip.

name: hades_idle
prompt: Cold, still idle, dark robes and cloak stir slightly as if in a cold wind, the tall staff stays planted in his right hand in every frame. He BLINKS ONCE in the middle of the clip.

name: eurydice_talk
prompt: Talking gently to someone in front of her, soft smile, one hand rising a little from her waist as she speaks, then returning.

name: elder_talk
prompt: Talking wisely and slowly, nodding, his free hand gesturing forward as he explains, the staff stays planted in his right hand in every frame.

name: merchant_talk
prompt: Talking cheerfully like a market seller, lifting the clay jar of ambrosia a little to show it, then lowering it; the jar stays in her hands in every frame.

name: villager_talk
prompt: Chatting with a friendly smile, tilting her head, the basket stays in the crook of her right arm in every frame.

name: zeus_talk
prompt: Speaking with authority, chin raised, his free hand opening in a commanding gesture, the lightning bolt stays raised in his right hand in every frame.

name: hermes_talk
prompt: Speaking quickly and playfully, grinning, bouncing lightly on his toes, pointing forward with his free hand, the staff stays in his right hand in every frame.

name: hades_talk
prompt: Speaking coldly and slowly, narrowing his eyes, his free hand closing into a fist, the staff stays planted in his right hand in every frame.
